newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Ten convicts, one policeman die in Pakistan clash.
newsitem.headline: Ten convicts, one policeman die in Pakistan clash.

text.p: Ten prisoners and one policeman were killed on Saturday when the prisoners tried to escape in the central Pakistan province of Punjab, police said.

A senior police officer said 19 convicts were being transported to the town of Bahawalpur from the town of Rahim Yar Khan when men believed to be their accomplices intercepted their bus at Chani Goth, about 40 km (25 miles) west of Bahawalpur.
The prisoners overpowered their guards, snatched their guns and killed one policeman and wounded six.
Police reinforcements arrived at the scene, surrounded the escaped convicts and killed 10 of them in a gun battle.
Police said firing continued late into the night and it was not clear what had happened to the nine surviving prisoners. No other details were immediately available.
